newsitem.title: FRANCE: U.S. stockmarket gain not unhealthy - Camdessus.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stockmarket gain not unhealthy - Camdessus.

text.p: International Monetary Fund managing director Michel Camdessus said in a newspaper interview on Friday that he did not believe the U.S. stockmarket had risen in an unhealthy fashion.

Asked by Le Monde what he thought of U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's December 5 comments about irrational exuberance of stockmarkets, Camdessus was quoted as saying "I do not believe the U.S. market has climbed in an unhealthy manner, in the sense that we cannot talk of inflationary, bank financing of growth."
